source.doc_type: CAR disclosure with reviewed interim financial information 3Q2025 (Thai)

notes: Quarterly (9 months to 30 September 2025 = year to date). First IFRS 17 interim year (2567 comparatives restated). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). CAR disclosure first, then the review report (Forvis Mazars). Units differ: the statement of profit or loss (p.8, three-month and nine-month columns side by side) is in Baht, the notes in thousand Baht. No PAA business, one portfolio (non-participating). Revenue 4.2.1 p.38 and expenses and reinsurance p.39 (three and nine months, both years). CSM roll-forward 4.3.1.2 p.44-45 (30 กันยายน 2568); new business 4.3.1.3 p.48 (totals used). Future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM column). The CSM insurance-finance row is negative for the nine months ((1,433); 2Q2025: 693): recorded as printed. A tax expense is recognised for the first time in the third quarter (3,971,114 Baht). RA release uses 4.2.1 (LRC basis, 26,662), not the AOC RA (29,982). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. The three-month profit or loss is the three-month column (p.8).
